title: spec: forwarding-plane endpoint-policy check not normatively specified (04/05) — Rule 255 RX reclassification depends on it
description: Found by codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-ilye.6 (security pass, performed by worker after reviewer-model timeouts). spec/03-adaptation.md Rule 255 section now (correctly, per the ilye DECIDED decision) accepts policy-invalid-endpoint datagrams at decode, assigning endpoint policy to 'packet origination and the forwarding decision'. Origination is normative in 03 (EMISSION constraint). But the forwarding decision has NO normative endpoint-policy (martian) check anywhere: spec/04-network.md has only the border-router multicast-to-internet rule (:196), and spec/05-routing.md has none — grep for martian/loopback/unspecified/IPv4-mapped/multicast-source/MUST-NOT-forward finds nothing applicable. Net effect: a codec-accepted packet with loopback/unspecified/IPv4-mapped source or out-of-scope multicast destination enters a forwarding plane whose policy behavior is unspecified, so the decided 'handled by the forwarding plane' outcome is not guaranteed. Fix: add a normative forwarding-plane endpoint-policy paragraph to spec/04-network.md (accept at link intake, apply policy at the forwarding decision, report locally, never transmit as protocol errors) mirroring the 03 error-precedence rule.
